rationale: User-approved layered-budget-v1; see docs/adr/0018-freeze-layered-accuracy-budgets.md for scope, engineering trade-offs, calibration selection bias, independent review and content-addressed evidence. Per-case reference log-score budgets are 2/5 millinats mean/peak, paired baseline excess is 1 millinat, and G_limit=ln(1.25) requires at least 80% of the best reference-token probability. Operator limits are fixed-profile maximum absolute errors, not universal BF16 tolerances. Exact structure, raw selection and required replay remain mandatory; no legacy verdict is changed and budget approval is not release acceptance.
